turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail:
What should I do if the tracking never updates?

12:21 PM

I understand how unsettling that can be. If your tracking has been created but does not update straight away, it can take a little time for the carrier to scan the parcel. If it remains unchanged for more than 10 business days after shipment, it will need further review by our team. For reference, Maison Close ships from France, and occasional customs delays can happen, although duties and taxes are covered for US deliveries.
